summary: Diff adds a backend migration and new VolumeTracking/TimeVolumeEntry structures, and updates frontend habit model utilities (and per summaries, optimistic compounding) to support timeString formatting and special Plank/Squash rules. However, the diff summary does not provide clear evidence that the backend monthly progression and time-unit initialization/update logic required by REQ-1/REQ-2 is implemented.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend monthly progression logic: Plank increases by +15 seconds per calendar month; Squash remains constant at 45:00 for every calendar month; other habits unchanged; persisted/reloaded correctly.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo is truncated before any monthly progression/compounding logic is shown. The diff summary provides no explicit evidence of Plank/Squash month-to-month backend computation changes or persistence behavior changes that meet the acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure updateHabitVolume preserves/initializes volumeTracking.unitType as "time" when a timeString is provided, preventing fallback to "reps" compounding.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary shows new types for time tracking, but does not show the updateHabitVolume implementation or any unitType initialization/preservation logic. Therefore it cannot be verified as implemented from the provided diff summary.

hallucinated_features.description: Stable-state migration that remaps volumeTracking and initializes every month’s minutes to 0 and timeString to null (potentially wiping existing per-month volume data).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asked to fix Plank/Squash progression and ensure correct time unit handling; it did not request a schema reset/migration that overwrites stored monthly values.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend actor-level migration wiring via `(with migration = Migration.run)` and importing Migration.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not explicitly requested by the BuildRequest; only allowed if an actual stable-state upgrade is required. The diff summary does not establish that such a breaking stable schema change is necessary for the requested progression fixes.
